snippet.title: Mini Bash - Coming Soon!
snippet.description:
👉 Visit https://minibashgame.com and sign up to be among the first notified when our campaign goes live!

Mini Bash is a safe online social world built for chaotic fun, cozy activities and endless games. Rally your friends, pick your Mini, and dive into an ever-growing mix of party games, fun quests, and action-packed battles. Team up or face off, explore new worlds, and collect rewards along the way. Whether you’re here to compete or playing just for fun, getting lost in Mini Bash is just the beginning.

Collect and customize hundreds of Minis to make your mark on the mayhem. Take on challenges, earn rewards, and build your collection as you discover new games and ways to play. Show off your latest finds, try a different look, and jump back into the action. Drop in for a quick round or spend an afternoon bouncing around with friends. There’s always another challenge to tackle and another reason to say, “One more game!”

Designed for all ages and built for cross-platform play by the creator of Club Penguin, whose games have reached hundreds of millions of players worldwide. Mini Bash brings the joy of classic online social worlds into the modern era of multiplayer gaming.

Mini world. Endless bash.
